basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old network engineer based in Austin, Texas. I've been diving deeper into the world of Dark Souls and networking (CCNP), and I love tinkering with Linux systems, especially Manjaro. In my free time, I enjoy playing the drums and dreaming about owning a Lamborghini. I'm usually online during late evenings after work. Currently single, I enjoy connecting with fellow gamers and tech enthusiasts online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology and recently obtained my CCNP certification. My interest in technology started in high school, and I have been self-teaching various Linux distributions. My gaming insights are mostly from personal experience and community interaction.
